summary_en: A transformer-based dual-domain photoacoustic reconstruction framework that trains paired SwinUNets on images produced by complementary inverse methods and enforces contrastive consistency after projection into the sinogram domain. It improves reconstruction under sparse detectors, restricted angular coverage, and noise, with phantom and in-vivo validation. Because image formation and reconstruction are central contributions, it belongs in the core library.

summary_en: A coded photoacoustic scanning method for mapping ultrasonic-transducer sensitivity and detecting structural defects. Pulsed-laser-diode spread-spectrum chirps and inverse-filter pulse compression improve SNR and electromagnetic-interference immunity while producing two-dimensional sensitivity maps and resolving transducer-layer timing. It is a direct, unusually strong match to the repository's acoustic-coded-imaging scope.
